item.text: {"case_id":"SHC072","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C08","C01","C09"],"selected_candidate_label":"C08","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C08 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. It uses the same integrated machinery for modifying a national monument: public-interest recitals supporting both an exclusion and an addition; descriptions of the affected tracts; temporary withdrawal of excluded lands from application, location, settlement, entry, or appropriation until an Interior officer orders otherwise; and the same express warning protecting monument features and lands. The child adapts this highly specific structure and closely matching language to Arches National Monument. C01 and C09 contain similarly strong machinery, but C08 is the closest overall match in language, function, and proximity in time.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"it would be in the public
